spellbook.finance/limitations: not_found means no shipped order in this workspace matched. An order SpellBook Finance never pulled, or never marked shipped, is absent.

An exact match on an order id, order label, tracking number or session id hides partial buyer matches for that identifier. A partial match searches only the most recently shipped orders. ambiguous means more than one order matched, so confirm the order with the person before recording.
This read carries no carrier scan state. SpellBook Finance does not detect a return to sender from USPS scans, so a package can be back with the seller while returnCase is null.
A stored postal status can lag a return. One returned letter still read in_transit after it was back with the seller, so trust the person over that status.

destinationSummary is null when the pull lines carry no buyer address, which is usual for TCGplayer orders. missingFields then names results[].matches[].destinationSummary. spellbook_returned_package_reship_prepare then reads the address from the packing slip linked to the order.

A TCGplayer pull sheet can hold several orders. Its match then counts every line on the sheet, and externalOrderId names one of those orders. To record one order from such a sheet, pass its order id as externalOrderId to spellbook_returned_package_record.
The returns workflow sits behind feature flag seller_returned_packages_v1, which is on for every account today. Error feature_disabled means the flag is off for this account.
Delegated calls require the workspace owner role.

annotations.title: Look up a shipped order and its return

description: Find shipped orders by marketplace order id, order label, tracking number, pull session id, or part of a buyer name or street line, and read each order's shipment facts with its newest return case. Use it when a package came back to the seller, such as a USPS return to sender, before calling spellbook_returned_package_record. Each match carries sessionId, marketplace, externalOrderId, buyerName, shippedAt, trackingNumber, destinationSummary, line counts, cardNames and returnCase. returnCase is null when no return was recorded for that shipment. Otherwise it carries caseId, status, returnReason, resolution and reshipExportPrepared. A held case with reshipExportPrepared false goes to spellbook_returned_package_reship_prepare next. A held case with reshipExportPrepared true goes to spellbook_returned_package_reship_tracking. Returns results with one row per identifier and status matched, ambiguous or not_found, plus missingFields.

identifiers.description: Up to 50 values to look up, each a marketplace order id, order label, tracking number, pull session id, or part of a buyer name or street line. Required, at least one.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that shipped the orders, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required.

name: spellbook_returned_package_lookup
